decision.observation: 9:30 pm, Sat. 6; the rod is raised with the bobber visible near the tip (~0.62,0.22); the cast is mid-flight toward the pond south of the farmer.
decision.hypothesis: The bobber will land in the pond below; a dip/'HIT!' followed by a C press has produced catches twice today.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6).
